teaser: You lace a boot at the trailhead, one knee against the open tailgate, and look up at the ridge you mean to build a path toward. Life path 22 is sometimes called the master builder, and as an ISFP you carry its blueprint inside hands that would rather feel the grain of a thing than draw it on paper first. The pull here is not whether you can build — it is whether a nature built for the present moment stays long enough to see the structure stand. Few numbers ask what 22 asks of a feeling, sensing temperament like this one.
excerpt: Three cars ahead in the car wash queue, and neither of you has spoken in ten minutes, though a hand finds a knee without looking over.
